recommended_action: Immediately patch Log4j 2.13.0 to version 2.16.0 or later due to critical remote code execution vulnerability in the internet-adjacent reporting service. Follow with nginx upgrade to 1.25.0+ and PostgreSQL to 14.9+.
rationale: Log4j 2.13.0 falls within the affected range (2.0-2.14.1) of CVE-2099-3001, a CVSS 10.0 remote code execution vulnerability via JNDI lookup, and the advisory confirms this component is internet-adjacent, making this CRITICAL severity. CVE-2099-3002 affects only version 2.15.0 so is not relevant here. nginx 1.22.1 is within the affected range (1.20.0-1.24.0) of CVE-2099-2001, a HIGH severity DoS issue in the reverse proxy tier. PostgreSQL 14.5 falls within the affected range (14.0-14.8) of CVE-2099-4001, a MEDIUM severity information disclosure issue; while it holds sensitive data, it is not directly internet-facing per the advisory. Overall severity is CRITICAL due to the internet-exposed RCE vulnerability in Log4j.
